Desktop OS.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows network-based attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting malformed image processing routines.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的整数溢出漏洞允许基于网络的攻击者通过利用格式错误的图像处理例程执行任意代码。

Desktop OS.reason: Remote access triggers buffer overflows in UEFI BIOS firmware, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution at boot time and compromising system integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Remote access triggers buffer overflows in UEFI BIOS firmware, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution at boot time and compromising system integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 远程访问会触发 UEFI BIOS 固件中的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致启动时执行任意代码并破坏系统完整性。

Desktop OS.reason: Authenticated X clients can exploit heap buffer overflows to crash or execute code within the X server context, directly impacting desktop environment stability and security.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Authenticated X clients can exploit heap buffer overflows to crash or execute code within the X server context, directly impacting desktop environment stability and security.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 已认证的 X 客户端可利用堆缓冲区溢出漏洞使 X 服务器上下文崩溃或执行代码，直接影响桌面环境的稳定性和安全性。

Desktop OS.reason: Windows-specific path validation bypass in Git allows malicious repositories to write files outside the worktree, enabling remote code execution on developer machines.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Windows-specific path validation bypass in Git allows malicious repositories to write files outside the worktree, enabling remote code execution on developer machines.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Git 中针对 Windows 的路径验证绕过漏洞允许恶意仓库在工作树外部写入文件，从而在开发人员机器上实现远程代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap buffer overflow in X.org/XWayland allows authenticated clients to trigger crashes or code execution in the display server context.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in X.org/XWayland allows authenticated clients to trigger crashes or code execution in the display server context.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: X.org/XWayland 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证客户端在显示服务器上下文中触发崩溃或代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: OS command injection in Topluyo Desktop Linux enables URL-controlled attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on target machines.
Desktop OS.reason_en: OS command injection in Topluyo Desktop Linux enables URL-controlled attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on target machines.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Topluyo Desktop Linux 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许受 URL 控制的攻击者在目标机器上执行任意系统命令。

Desktop OS.reason: Unauthenticated Java RMI service in NoviGest Desktop App permits remote method invocation, credential theft, and arbitrary SQL queries.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Unauthenticated Java RMI service in NoviGest Desktop App permits remote method invocation, credential theft, and arbitrary SQL queries.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: NoviGest Desktop App 中未认证的 Java RMI 服务允许远程方法调用、凭据窃取和任意 SQL 查询。

Mobile Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android allows authorized attackers to perform network-based spoofing attacks on mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android allows authorized attackers to perform network-based spoofing attacks on mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已认证的攻击者在移动设备上实施基于网络的欺骗攻击。

Mobile Security.reason: CVSS 8.1 Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
Mobile Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 的 iOS 版 Microsoft 365 Copilot 访问控制不当漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升。

Mobile Security.reason: CVSS 7.5 Time-of-check time-of-use race condition in Edge for Android enables remote code execution via malicious web content.
Mobile Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 Time-of-check time-of-use race condition in Edge for Android enables remote code execution via malicious web content.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 的 Android 版 Edge 检查时使用竞争条件漏洞允许通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行。

Mobile Security.reason: CVSS 7.4 External file path control in Edge for Android allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network.
Mobile Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 External file path control in Edge for Android allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: CVSS 7.4 的 Android 版 Edge 外部文件路径控制漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的信息泄露。

Mobile Security.reason: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android bypasses app sandboxing, potentially exposing sensitive user files or enabling local code execution on mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android bypasses app sandboxing, potentially exposing sensitive user files or enabling local code execution on mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的路径遍历漏洞绕过了应用沙箱机制，可能暴露敏感用户文件或允许在移动设备上执行本地代码。

Mobile Security.reason: Path traversal in Edge for Android allows local information disclosure, potentially exposing sensitive user data and application files.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Path traversal in Edge for Android allows local information disclosure, potentially exposing sensitive user data and application files.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Android 版 Edge 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致本地信息泄露，可能暴露敏感用户数据和应用程序文件。

Mobile Security.reason: Improper restriction of rendered UI layers in the Bing App for iOS enables network-based UI spoofing attacks to trick users.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Improper restriction of rendered UI layers in the Bing App for iOS enables network-based UI spoofing attacks to trick users.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: iOS版Bing应用中渲染的UI层限制不当，可导致基于网络的UI欺骗攻击以诱骗用户。

Mobile Security.reason: Unauthenticated access to the Android Debug Bridge daemon provides immediate system footholds and facilitates rapid privilege escalation to root on affected devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to the Android Debug Bridge daemon provides immediate system footholds and facilitates rapid privilege escalation to root on affected devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 对Android Debug Bridge守护进程的无需身份验证访问可立即提供系统立足点，并促使在受影响设备上快速提权至root。

Mobile Security.reason: Missing authorization in a native binder service allows unprivileged applications to execute arbitrary OS commands as root, completely bypassing Android sandbox restrictions.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in a native binder service allows unprivileged applications to execute arbitrary OS commands as root, completely bypassing Android sandbox restrictions.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 原生binder服务中缺少授权检查，允许非特权应用以root身份执行任意操作系统命令，从而完全绕过Android沙箱限制。

Mobile Security.reason: Logcat-based command injection in a privileged helper daemon enables local processes to achieve full root compromise by manipulating system logs.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Logcat-based command injection in a privileged helper daemon enables local processes to achieve full root compromise by manipulating system logs.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 特权辅助守护进程中基于Logcat的命令注入使本地进程能够通过操纵系统日志获取完整的root权限。

Mobile Security.reason: Incorrect permission assignment in the Windows Mobile Broadband driver allows local privilege escalation on cellular-connected mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in the Windows Mobile Broadband driver allows local privilege escalation on cellular-connected mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Windows移动宽带驱动程序中的权限分配错误可在蜂窝网络连接的设备上导致本地提权。

Mobile Security.reason: Flawed signature verification in unconfirmed mempool transactions allows malicious servers to replace broadcasts, potentially stealing user cryptocurrency funds.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Flawed signature verification in unconfirmed mempool transactions allows malicious servers to replace broadcasts, potentially stealing user cryptocurrency funds.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 未确认的mempool交易中签名验证存在缺陷，允许恶意服务器替换广播，可能导致用户加密货币资金被盗。

IoT Security.reason: Critical remote backdoor in D-Link home routers allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full device control via crafted CGI arguments.
IoT Security.reason_en: Critical remote backdoor in D-Link home routers allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full device control via crafted CGI arguments.
IoT Security.reason_zh: D-Link家用路由器中存在关键远程后门，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用构造的CGI参数获取设备的完全控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Missing authentication in Signal K Server enables unauthenticated log downloads that reveal JWT secrets for persistent administrative takeover.
IoT Security.reason_en: Missing authentication in Signal K Server enables unauthenticated log downloads that reveal JWT secrets for persistent administrative takeover.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Signal K Server中缺少身份验证机制，允许未经身份验证的用户下载日志并泄露JWT密钥，从而实现持久的管理接管。

IoT Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Totolink router firmware allows authenticated remote code execution, severely compromising home and small-office network gateways.
IoT Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Totolink router firmware allows authenticated remote code execution, severely compromising home and small-office network gateways.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Totolink路由器固件中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许经身份验证的攻击者执行远程代码，严重危及家庭及小型办公网络网关的安全。

IoT Security.reason: Hostname processing overflow in the same router model enables arbitrary command execution, posing persistent risks to IoT device confidentiality and network perimeter security.
IoT Security.reason_en: Hostname processing overflow in the same router model enables arbitrary command execution, posing persistent risks to IoT device confidentiality and network perimeter security.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 该路由器型号的主机名处理溢出漏洞可导致任意命令执行，对物联网设备机密性及网络边界安全构成长期威胁。

IoT Security.reason: Authentication bypass via IP spoofing in the CGM CLININET rsyncd service allows unauthorized file editing on connected medical devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass via IP spoofing in the CGM CLININET rsyncd service allows unauthorized file editing on connected medical devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: CGM CLININET rsyncd服务中存在通过IP欺骗绕过身份验证的漏洞，允许对已连接的医疗设备进行未经授权的文件编辑。

IoT Security.reason: A hardcoded backdoor in the root-privileged assistant daemon allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands via USB, undermining device integrity.
IoT Security.reason_en: A hardcoded backdoor in the root-privileged assistant daemon allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands via USB, undermining device integrity.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 具有root权限的助手守护进程中存在硬编码后门，允许物理接触攻击者通过USB执行任意操作系统命令，破坏设备完整性。

IoT Security.reason: Missing authorization in the update service permits unprivileged apps to trigger destructive operations like factory resets and system shutdowns on drone hardware.
IoT Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in the update service permits unprivileged apps to trigger destructive operations like factory resets and system shutdowns on drone hardware.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 更新服务中缺少授权检查，允许非特权应用对无人机硬件触发恢复出厂设置和系统关机等破坏性操作。

IoT Security.reason: Remote command injection in TOTOLINK router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full device control via manipulated module upload arguments.
IoT Security.reason_en: Remote command injection in TOTOLINK router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full device control via manipulated module upload arguments.
IoT Security.reason_zh: TOTOLINK路由器固件中存在远程命令注入漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用篡改的模块上传参数获取设备的完全控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in TOTOLINK wireless configuration CGI enables remote code execution, exposing home and small business networks to complete compromise.
IoT Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in TOTOLINK wireless configuration CGI enables remote code execution, exposing home and small business networks to complete compromise.
IoT Security.reason_zh: TOTOLINK无线配置CGI中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使家庭及中小企业网络面临被完全攻陷的风险。

IoT Security.reason: Remote buffer overflow in Tenda router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to take full control of the network device.
IoT Security.reason_en: Remote buffer overflow in Tenda router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to take full control of the network device.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Tenda路由器固件中存在远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可借此获取网络设备的完全控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Alpine Android Auto service enables remote code execution on vehicle infotainment systems without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Alpine Android Auto service enables remote code execution on vehicle infotainment systems without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Alpine Android Auto服务中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在无需身份验证的情况下于车载信息娱乐系统中执行远程代码。

IoT Security.reason: Critical stack-based buffer overflow in router firmware web management interface allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
IoT Security.reason_en: Critical stack-based buffer overflow in router firmware web management interface allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 路由器固件Web管理界面中存在关键的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者执行远程代码。

IoT Security.reason: Configuration flaw forces empty passwords in firmware, leaving home networking devices completely unprotected against unauthorized access.
IoT Security.reason_en: Configuration flaw forces empty passwords in firmware, leaving home networking devices completely unprotected against unauthorized access.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 固件中的配置缺陷强制使用空密码，导致家庭网络设备在防范未授权访问方面完全缺乏保护。

IoT Security.reason: Exposed dangerous functions in automotive infotainment frameworks allow network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_en: Exposed dangerous functions in automotive infotainment frameworks allow network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 车载信息娱乐框架中暴露的危险函数允许网络邻近攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下执行任意代码。

IoT Security.reason: ESPHome Dashboard binds to all network interfaces while bypassing authentication, exposing home automation controls to local networks.
IoT Security.reason_en: ESPHome Dashboard binds to all network interfaces while bypassing authentication, exposing home automation controls to local networks.
IoT Security.reason_zh: ESPHome Dashboard绑定至所有网络接口且未实施身份验证，导致家庭自动化控制面板暴露于局域网中。

IoT Security.reason: Missing access controls in Xibo digital signage allow authenticated users to modify or delete any layout, disrupting content delivery workflows.
IoT Security.reason_en: Missing access controls in Xibo digital signage allow authenticated users to modify or delete any layout, disrupting content delivery workflows.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Xibo数字标牌中缺少访问控制机制，允许已认证用户修改或删除任意布局，从而干扰内容分发工作流。

IoT Security.reason: Offline-vulnerable database backups in AXIS Camera Station require immediate credential rotation to prevent offline cracking attacks.
IoT Security.reason_en: Offline-vulnerable database backups in AXIS Camera Station require immediate credential rotation to prevent offline cracking attacks.
IoT Security.reason_zh: AXIS Camera Station中存在离线漏洞的数据库备份要求立即轮换凭据，以防止离线破解攻击。

IoT Security.reason: Missing authorization checks allow any authenticated user to start, stop, or query IoT gateway tunnels, potentially disrupting connected industrial or smart devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Missing authorization checks allow any authenticated user to start, stop, or query IoT gateway tunnels, potentially disrupting connected industrial or smart devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 缺少授权检查使得任何已认证用户均可启动、停止或查询IoT网关隧道，可能中断已连接的工业或智能设备运行。

Cloud Security.reason: Incorrect authorization in Azure Arc allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges across hybrid cloud management infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Azure Arc allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges across hybrid cloud management infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Arc中的授权逻辑错误允许未经身份验证的攻击者在混合云管理基础设施中提升权限。

Cloud Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Azure SQL Database enables unauthenticated privilege escalation and internal network reconnaissance.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure SQL Database enables unauthenticated privilege escalation and internal network reconnaissance.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中存在服务端请求伪造漏洞，可实现无需身份验证的提权及内部网络侦察。

Cloud Security.reason: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows unauthenticated remote code execution in managed database clusters.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows unauthenticated remote code execution in managed database clusters.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra中存在参数注入漏洞，允许在托管数据库集群中实现无需身份验证的远程代码执行。

Cloud Security.reason: A perfect CVSS score indicates trivial exploitation, allowing attackers to hijack DNS configurations and compromise cloud identity and resolution services.
Cloud Security.reason_en: A perfect CVSS score indicates trivial exploitation, allowing attackers to hijack DNS configurations and compromise cloud identity and resolution services.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 满分CVSS评分表明该漏洞极易利用，攻击者可借此劫持DNS配置并破坏云身份与解析服务。

Cloud Security.reason: This access control flaw breaks tenant isolation in Azure PaaS environments, potentially granting attackers full control over hosted applications and underlying resources.
Cloud Security.reason_en: This access control flaw breaks tenant isolation in Azure PaaS environments, potentially granting attackers full control over hosted applications and underlying resources.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 此访问控制缺陷破坏了Azure PaaS环境中的租户隔离机制，可能使攻击者获得对托管应用及底层资源的完全控制权。

Cloud Security.reason: Authentication failures in Azure Key Vault expose cryptographic secrets and certificates, severely impacting downstream application security and compliance.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authentication failures in Azure Key Vault expose cryptographic secrets and certificates, severely impacting downstream application security and compliance.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault中的身份验证缺陷会泄露加密密钥与证书，严重影响下游应用的安全性及合规性。

Cloud Security.reason: AI-integrated productivity suites are increasingly targeted; this deserialization flaw enables remote code execution within the cloud collaboration environment.
Cloud Security.reason_en: AI-integrated productivity suites are increasingly targeted; this deserialization flaw enables remote code execution within the cloud collaboration environment.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 集成AI的生产力套件正成为日益频繁的攻击目标；此反序列化漏洞可在云协作环境中实现远程代码执行。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 10 Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB allows unauthenticated remote code execution, critically threatening cloud data integrity.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 10 Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB allows unauthenticated remote code execution, critically threatening cloud data integrity.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 10 Azure Cosmos DB 访问控制不当，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重威胁云数据完整性。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 8 Improper access control in Azure API Management allows compromised accounts to execute code over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 8 Improper access control in Azure API Management allows compromised accounts to execute code over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8 Azure API Management 访问控制不当，允许被攻陷的账户通过网络执行代码。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 Command injection in Microsoft Copilot enables unauthenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive data over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Command injection in Microsoft Copilot enables unauthenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive data over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 Microsoft Copilot 命令注入漏洞使未授权攻击者能够通过网络窃取敏感数据。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 8.1 Missing authentication in Azure CycleCloud allows privilege escalation within cloud orchestration and deployment environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 Missing authentication in Azure CycleCloud allows privilege escalation within cloud orchestration and deployment environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 Azure CycleCloud 缺少身份验证机制，可在云编排与部署环境中导致权限提升。

Cloud Security.reason: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, this code injection flaw in SharePoint allows network-based remote code execution, severely impacting cloud collaboration platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, this code injection flaw in SharePoint allows network-based remote code execution, severely impacting cloud collaboration platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 根据CISA KEV记录，该SharePoint代码注入漏洞已在野外被积极利用，支持基于网络的远程代码执行，严重影响云协作平台。

Cloud Security.reason: Critical deserialization vulnerability in Dynamics NAV enables remote code execution over the network, threatening enterprise resource planning and business continuity.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Critical deserialization vulnerability in Dynamics NAV enables remote code execution over the network, threatening enterprise resource planning and business continuity.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Dynamics NAV 存在关键反序列化漏洞，可支持网络远程代码执行，威胁企业资源规划及业务连续性。

Cloud Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in on-premises Dynamics 365 allows network-based code execution, compromising enterprise workflow and data management services.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in on-premises Dynamics 365 allows network-based code execution, compromising enterprise workflow and data management services.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 本地部署版 Dynamics 365 对不可信数据进行反序列化，可导致基于网络的代码执行，破坏企业工作流与数据管理服务。

Cloud Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server permits authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, directly disrupting organizational email infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server permits authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, directly disrupting organizational email infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行代码，直接扰乱组织邮件基础设施。

Cloud Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse exposes cloud analytics pipelines to remote code execution, risking sensitive data processing environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse exposes cloud analytics pipelines to remote code execution, risking sensitive data processing environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞使云分析管道面临远程代码执行风险，危及敏感数据处理环境。

Cloud Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening global identity federation and tenant access controls.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening global identity federation and tenant access controls.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 对不可信数据进行反序列化，可实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行，威胁全球身份联合与租户访问控制。

Cloud Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Exchange Online allows attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges within Microsoft 365 email infrastructure, risking mass data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Exchange Online allows attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges within Microsoft 365 email infrastructure, risking mass data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Exchange Online 服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许攻击者在内部横向移动并在 Microsoft 365 邮件基础设施中提升权限，面临大规模数据泄露风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Untrusted data deserialization in Azure Service Bus permits remote code execution, jeopardizing message queue integrity and downstream cloud workload security.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in Azure Service Bus permits remote code execution, jeopardizing message queue integrity and downstream cloud workload security.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 不可信数据反序列化漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及消息队列完整性及下游云工作负载安全。

Cloud Security.reason: Modification of assumed-immutable data in Azure Active Directory allows privilege escalation and directory policy tampering, fundamentally breaking enterprise identity governance.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Modification of assumed-immutable data in Azure Active Directory allows privilege escalation and directory policy tampering, fundamentally breaking enterprise identity governance.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中被视为不可变的数据遭篡改，可导致权限提升和目录策略被修改，从根本上破坏企业身份治理。

summary: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws within the Microsoft ecosystem, impacting desktop environments via Edge and Windows services, cloud infrastructure through Azure and SharePoint, and developer tools like Visual Studio Code. Parallel high-severity risks affect IoT networking gear from manufacturers such as D-Link and Totolink due to hardcoded backdoors and buffer overflows, alongside significant injection and deserialization vulnerabilities compromising database middleware and web-facing enterprise applications. These diverse attack vectors collectively threaten endpoint security, cloud tenant isolation, and the integrity of industrial and medical control systems requiring immediate remediation.
